title: ya abalfazl ya abalfazl
body:
Abbas Abbas Abbas
Abalfazl Abalfazl Abalfazl Alamdar
Ya kashefal karbe an wajhil Hussain, Iqshif karbi behaqqe akhikal Hussain
Saqqiye Aale Abba Abalfazl
Tishna Labe Karbala Abalfazl
Chishma E Aabe Baqa Abalfazl - 2
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Karb Shabbir Ke Chehre Se Mitane Wale
Ranj Se Aale Muhammad Ko Chudane Wale
Tham Le Hath Pareshan Azadaron Ka
Aye Sakina Ke Liye Bazu Katane Wale
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Toot Jaye Na Meri Aaas aye Ummeede Haram
Mere Zakhmo Ka Faqt Aap Ho Ghazi Marham
Arbaien Pe Hame Bulwale Ziyarat Ke Liye
Aap Ko Pehlu Shakista Kisi Bibi Ki qasam
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum Ko Dunya Ka Tarafdar Na Hone De Na
Sirf Bato Ka Azadar Na Hone De Na
Sadqa Shehzadi Ruqaiya Ke Bandhe Hatho Ka
Ham Ko Mushkil Main Giraftar Na Hone De Na
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Likhdo Taqdeer Main Phir Karbala Jana Ghazi
Apna Darbar Hame Jald Dikhana Ghazi
Wasta Deta Hu Zakhme Ali Akbar Ka Tumhe
Karbala Sare Javano Ko Bulana Ghazi
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Us ghadi nazro me ashoor ki rudaad aayi
aansu aankhon me bhare hoton pe faryaad aayi
saamne paani tha aur pi bhi nahi sakta tha
mujko roze me teri pyaas bohot yaad ayi
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum ho shabbir ki beti ka sahara ghazi
Bin tumhare na huva uska guzara ghazi
Shimr ne jab bhi sakina to tamache maare
usne baba ko nahi tumko pukara ghazi
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Us ghadi khaymaye sadaat me kohram hua
Khoon bhara jis ghadi ranse tera parcham aaya
Pyaasi mar jaungi aur paani nahi maangungi
Todkar kuza ye maasoom sakina ne kaha
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Tune aacha hua bhai ki na gurbat dekhi
Taane deta tha koi shah pe hasta tha koi
Apne bhai ki madad ke liye ran me aakar
Laash zainab ne uthayi hai Ali Akbar ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah ne rokar kaha - Abal Fazl
Uttho mere bawafa - Abal Fazl
Tanha hai bhai tera - 2
Abal fazl abal fazl abal fazl alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aakhri lamho me shabbir bade pyaase the
Badi hasrat se sue neher nazar karte the
Shimr has has ke lagata raha tera (13) zarbe Aur har waar pe shabbir sada dete the
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Mir sajjad baya'n kaise kare wo manzar
Shaam ki fauj ne jab aag lagayi aaker
Chhinne aa gaye jab sar se rida Zainab ki
Us ghadi kehti rahi saniye zehra rokar
<<MINI>>
Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl Ya Abalfazl
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya kashife karbe an wajhil Hussain
